note: Source 6 (authored, not generated). NWH behaviours the game or the mods rely on, beyond member existence. Member names are from the mod harness stubs (verify/mod-harness/stubs/GameStubs.cs, copied from decompiled NWH with file:line cites) and the decoded FSM data (inputs/fsm-template-dump.md); the census resolves every listed member against the real DLLs. 'stance': keep = SPO must reproduce it; replace = SPO provides it natively (the NWH version goes away); must-not-have = an NWH behaviour SPO must make impossible (a horrid-states item). Test sketches become real tests in the milestone named.

behaviours.title: FSM shift requests: input.ShiftInto / ShiftUp / ShiftDown
behaviours.behaviour: The game never writes transmission.Gear. INPUT_GearChange / INPUT_HShifter write input.ShiftInto (int: -1 = R, 0 = N, 1..5); INPUT_ShiftUpDown writes ShiftUp/ShiftDown = true. NWH's ManualShift consumes them each update; ShiftInto's 'no request' sentinel is -999 (stub :91) and anything > -100 is a request (stub :341).
behaviours.reliedOnBy: game FSMs (196 + 14 + 14 writes), the tuning mod's shift controller
behaviours.testSketch: Drive the SPO transmission with the exact FSM write sequences from template_dump (R, N, 1..5 one-shots; H-shifter hold/release; up/down pulses) and assert the engaged gear after each; a request is consumed exactly once; the -999 sentinel never shifts; an out-of-range request (e.g. 9 on a 5-speed) is clamped/ignored and gear index stays valid.

behaviours.title: Gear list layout [reverse..., 0 (neutral), forward...] and the Gear index
behaviours.behaviour: TransmissionComponent.gears is a List<float> laid out reverse ratios first, then 0 for neutral, then forward ratios (stub :299); Gear is -1.. for reverse, 0 neutral, 1.. forward, mapped onto that list. NWH indexes gears[gearIndex] unguarded.
behaviours.reliedOnBy: the tuning mod (gear ratio editing, 12-gear configs), CheckTag FSM (finalGearRatio)
behaviours.testSketch: Property test: for random gear lists (1-3 reverse, 1-12 forward) and random shift sequences, the gear index always maps inside the list; shrinking the list while in a high gear clamps instead of throwing.

behaviours.title: Shift delegate reassignment on transmissionType change
behaviours.behaviour: NWH reassigns shiftDelegate (Manual/Automatic/CVT) whenever transmissionType changes (stub :318-326, :487-495), silently replacing any delegate a mod installed. CheckTag writes transmissionType (28 writes).
behaviours.reliedOnBy: nothing should — the tuning mod needed a delegate guard because of it
behaviours.testSketch: Toggle transmissionType through every value 1000x with an SPO shift policy installed; assert the policy object is never replaced and no shift happens as a side effect of the toggle.

behaviours.title: Automatic gear skipping (the 12-gear 'launch from gear 8' bug)
behaviours.behaviour: NWH's AutomaticShift can jump several gears at once (stub :355-390), e.g. launching a 12-speed from gear 8.
behaviours.testSketch: No-hunting grid: every (gear count 4..12) x (throttle 0..1) x (load) launch from standstill starts in gear 1 and never changes by more than one gear per shift event (kickdown excepted, bounded and explicit).

behaviours.title: Live powertrain relinking: Output / OutputB
behaviours.behaviour: PowertrainComponent.Output (and DifferentialComponent.OutputB) can be reassigned at runtime to re-route torque (stub :152, :539); the tuning mod rewires drivetrain layouts live.
behaviours.testSketch: Layout rewiring pass: switch FWD -> RWD -> AWD -> back while driving (harness), assert torque reaches exactly the wheels of the active layout, no NaN, no lost/duplicated torque (sum of wheel torques == driveline output within tolerance).

behaviours.title: Torque and brake modifier lists
behaviours.behaviour: EngineComponent.powerModifiers and Brakes.brakeTorqueModifiers are lists of delegates evaluated every update (stub :253, :753); mods append to them (ABS/TCS-style assists).
behaviours.stance: replace (SPO assist layer) — keep the lists working while NWH is still in charge of that subsystem
behaviours.testSketch: A modifier returning 0.5 halves engine torque / brake torque that tick; removing it restores the original; an exception inside a modifier is contained (vehicle stays drivable).

behaviours.title: WheelUAPI setters take effect live
behaviours.behaviour: Writes to NWH.Common.Vehicles.WheelUAPI setters (SpringMaxForce, SpringMaxLength, DamperBumpRate, DamperReboundRate, friction grip/stiffness, SteerAngle) and the FSMs' WheelController writes (Radius, Mass, Width, spring.maxLength, forwardFriction.grip) change the next physics step.
behaviours.reliedOnBy: the tuning mod (suspension/grip presets), game FSMs (846 WheelController writes)
behaviours.testSketch: Change each parameter mid-drive in the harness; the very next tick's force uses the new value; extreme values (0, negative, huge, NaN) are rejected or clamped at the boundary and the vehicle stays recoverable.

behaviours.title: Exit zeroes throttle/brakes; other inputs go stale
behaviours.behaviour: The Drive FSM's exit state writes input.Throttle = 0 and input.Brakes = 0 (fsm-template-dump.md), but nothing resets steering, handbrake, clutch or a pending shift request — the 'stale input after exit' trap.
behaviours.stance: keep the writes working; must-not-have the stale state (SPO inputs expire to neutral after N ticks without a write)
behaviours.testSketch: Replay enter -> drive -> exit; after exit, with no further writes, every SPO input decays to neutral within N ticks; re-entry starts from neutral.

behaviours.title: Fuel cans write FuelModuleWrapper.module.amount
behaviours.behaviour: UseCan FSMs set NWH.VehiclePhysics2.Modules.Fuel.FuelModuleWrapper.module.amount (53 writes); the engine stops when fuel is empty.
behaviours.stance: keep (NWH's module stays in place under inside-out)
behaviours.testSketch: Set amount to 0 with the engine running: SPO engine stops within one tick and restarts after amount > 0 + EngineStartStop; negative/NaN amount is clamped.

behaviours.title: Engine-part swaps rewrite the gearbox: CheckTag + VehicleController.SetGearArrayByValue
behaviours.behaviour: The engine-part FSMs (CheckTag, state 'vehPart', one per engine prefab, e.g. '594cc I2 23HP 39Nm Gasoline') call VehicleController.SetGearArrayByValue via CallMethod (16 calls) and set transmissionType / UpshiftRPM / DownshiftRPM / finalGearRatio and engine parameters by SetProperty. SetGearArrayByValue is not part of stock NWH Vehicle Physics 2 as far as the builder knows: the game's NWH DLL is probably developer-modified (consistent with SPEC §9: no version stamp). Found by the M0a FSM census (builder preview, 2026-10-05).
behaviours.stance: keep (SPO's transmission must accept a new gear array at runtime, mid-session, safely)
behaviours.testSketch: Swap engines (and thus gear arrays: 4..12 forward gears) while parked, while driving in a high gear, and while a shift is pending; gear index stays valid, no auto-skip, no NaN, the new ratios apply on the next tick.

behaviours.title: Floating origin while driving: NWH.Common.FloatingOrigin added on enter, destroyed on exit
behaviours.behaviour: The Drive FSM AddComponent's NWH.Common.FloatingOrigin.FloatingOrigin when the player enters a vehicle and DestroyComponent's it on exit (56 FSM references), and sets distanceThreshold (14 writes); the InCar FSM toggles its 'enabled'. While present, NWH shifts the world origin once the player is farther than the threshold — every root transform, including PhysX rigidbodies, jumps by the same offset. Found by the M0a FSM census (builder preview).
behaviours.stance: keep — SPO must tolerate origin shifts: no world-space state carried across a shift in Track A; Track B needs an explicit origin/region contract (SPEC R5)
behaviours.testSketch: Shift the origin by (5000, 0, -3000) mid-drive in the harness: velocities, wheel/suspension state, gear and engine state are unchanged; no impulse spike; the next tick's forces equal the no-shift run's within float tolerance.
